project.description:
DWM — the UI subsystem placeholder, codenamed after Windows' Desktop Window Manager (the NT/hardware metaphor the project uses: core=NT kernel, board=PCB, compat=AppCompat). Reserved as the seat of the in-game UI layer.
CONCEPT-ONLY, INTENTIONALLY EMPTY. All prior UI implementations (the DWM MD3 component tree, the dwm-gl / dwm-skiko / dwm-imgui render backends, the qml4j desktop) were removed; this module now carries no code — only the architectural intent. Recoverable in git: see branches backup/qml4j-desktop and backup/overlay-guiscreen. See dwm/README.md for the design intent.
Contract if ever re-implemented: a detachable AUXILIARY layer with zero security power, importing no core class, discovered by Board via the reflective Backplane. Delete dwm and everything still compiles.
